next.reason: 1985: "ACCEPT identifier-2 FROM { DATE | DAY | DAY-OF-WEEK | TIME }"; 2023: "DATE [ YYYYMMDD ] ... DAY [ YYYYDDD ] ... [ END-ACCEPT ]; plus Format 3 (screen): ACCEPT screen-name-1 ...". 2023 keeps both 1985 formats but adds the YYYYMMDD and YYYYDDD phrases, END-ACCEPT and a screen format. These are added cases, so it accepts programs that 1985 refused.
